Then find and open the provisioned dashboard named 'Service health' (use the Dashboards/search page). Report the titles of all panels on that dashboard, exactly as shown on screen.

steps.instruction: On the dashboard '{{runid}} Bench Dashboard' (URL http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/{{02-create.url.p1}}/{{runid}}-bench-dashboard), do two things and save: (1) Add the tag 'bench' to the dashboard (Dashboard settings > General > Tags, add 'bench'). (2) Set the dashboard's time range to the last 6 hours (Last 6 hours) via the top-right time picker. Then click Save dashboard, and in the save dialog make sure the 'Update default time range' checkbox IS TICKED (so the 6-hour range is persisted into the saved dashboard), then confirm the save. Verify afterwards: reload the page, open Dashboard settings > General and confirm the tag 'bench' is listed, and confirm the saved default time range is Last 6 hours. Report what you observed.

recorded.tag_verified_after_reload: yes - Settings > General Tags list shows 'bench' (with Remove "bench" tag button)

steps.instruction: On the dashboard '{{runid}} Bench Dashboard' (URL http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/{{02-create.url.p1}}/{{runid}}-bench-dashboard), set the dashboard's auto-refresh interval to '1m' (1 minute) using the refresh interval picker in the top-right toolbar (the dropdown next to the refresh button, choose 1m). This should mark the dashboard as having unsaved changes; click Save dashboard and confirm the save. Verify persistence: reload the page and open Dashboard settings > JSON Model, and confirm the 'refresh' field is set to '1m'. Also confirm the top bar refresh picker shows 1m after reload. Report what you observed, including the exact refresh value in the JSON model.
